faq_heading: Homes near Berkshire Park Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Berkshire Park Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Berkshire Park Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Berkshire Park Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Berkshire Park Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 61 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,187,500, townhomes $665,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Berkshire Park Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Berkshire Park Elementary the median was 42 days on the market, closing at 95.5% of the list price, with 7% of sales above the list price for the 61 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Berkshire Park Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Mountainview Montessori (0.9 km north), Johnston Heights Secondary (1.0 km north) and Bonaccord Elementary (1.1 km north-west).

Berkshire Park Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 15372 94 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Berkshire Park Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Berkshire Park Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Berkshire Park Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Berkshire Park Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 61 homes sold within 1 km of Berkshire Park Elementary: 46 houses and 13 townhomes. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,187,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Berkshire Park Elementary

32 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Berkshire Park Elementary in a straight line (20 elementary, 10 secondary, 2 other; 4 independent). The closest is Mountainview Montessori, 0.9 km away, and the farthest on this list is Simon Cunningham Elementary, 2.7 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Johnston Heights Secondary (1.0 km); the nearest independent school is St Matthew's Elementary (1.8 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is North Surrey Secondary (1.2 km). Other elementary schools close by: Mountainview Montessori (0.9 km north), Bonaccord Elementary (1.1 km north-west), Woodland Park Elementary (1.1 km south-east), William F. Davidson Elementary (1.2 km north), Serpentine Heights Elementary (1.5 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Mountainview Montessori, 0.9 km north of Berkshire Park Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Berkshire Park Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Berkshire Park Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Berkshire Park Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Berkshire Park Elementary was $1,187,500, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Mountainview Montessori, the nearest other elementary school, 0.9 km north of Berkshire Park Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
